claude.sample_unit: colorectal surgery patient educational topics (baseline materials and matched LLM-generated documents)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education materials versus sixth-grade guidelines
links.effect: Baseline Grade Level 7.0-9.8; ChatGPT Metric-based prompt Grade Level 5.2 vs 8.1 baseline (P<.01); Perplexity materials significantly less readable except Metric-based prompt, not different from baseline.
links.quote: Both existing materials and the majority of educational materials created by large language models did not meet readability recommendations.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient materials relative to recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Baseline materials did not meet sixth-grade guidelines: Grade Level 7.0-9.8, Modified Grade Level 9.6-11.5, Ease 53.1-65.0.
links.quote: Baseline materials did not meet sixth-grade readability guidelines based on grade level (Grade Level 7.0-9.8 and Modified Grade Level 9.6-11.5) or ease of readability (Ease 53.1-65.0).

links.outcome: Readability of LLM output by prompt type (Basic, Iterative, Metric-based)
links.effect: ChatGPT Metric-based prompt improved readability vs baseline: Grade Level 5.2 vs 8.1, Modified Grade Level 7.3 vs 10.3, Ease 70.5 vs 60.4, all P<.01; other prompts and Perplexity varied.
links.quote: The variability in performance highlights the importance of the prompt used with large language models.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering with explicit readability metrics (sixth-grade level, short sentences, short words) to improve LLM patient education readability

links.outcome: reading level of patient education materials
links.effect: Baseline Grade Level 7.0-9.8, Modified 9.6-11.5, Ease 53.1-65.0; majority LLM materials did not meet recommendations; ChatGPT Metric average Grade Level 5.2 met recommendations.
links.quote: Both existing materials and the majority of educational materials created by large language models did not meet readability recommendations.

links.effect: ChatGPT Metric prompt: Grade Level 5.2 vs 8.1, Modified 7.3 vs 10.3, Ease 70.5 vs 60.4, all P < .01; Perplexity Metric did not statistically differ.
links.quote: The variability in performance highlights the importance of the prompt used with large language models.

links.effect: ChatGPT met sixth-grade guidelines only with metric-based prompts (Grade Level 5.2 vs 8.1 baseline, P < .01); Perplexity was less readable or not different; most LLM materials failed readability recommendations.
links.quote: Both existing materials and the majority of educational materials created by large language models did not meet readability recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering with metric-based constraints (requesting reading level, short sentences, and short words) to improve the readability of AI-generated patient education materials
